reasons: Covers accept, reject and eligibility rules.
Tests both valid and forbidden combinations.

a label that says how well a fact is supported, such as source-stated or conflicted
a record of how a fact was obtained, such as from a source or by inference

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup and shared values
sections.what: Brings in the evidence tools and sets a fixed fake hash used by every record.
sections.why: Keeps tests focused on the rule being checked.

sections.name: _pdf_source
sections.title: PDF source helper
sections.what: Builds a PDF source that points to a page, a region on the page and a yard dimension callout.
sections.why: Gives tests a valid page-based source.

sections.name: _record
sections.title: Evidence record helper
sections.what: Builds a valid accepted dimension fact by default and applies any overrides the test asks for.
sections.why: Lets each test change only the field it checks.

sections.name: test_truth_states_are_exactly_the_phase2_contract
sections.title: Truth states are fixed
sections.what: Checks that the set of truth states is exactly the agreed list.

sections.name: test_page_evidence_requires_page_and_normalized_region
sections.title: Page evidence rules
sections.what: Checks a PDF source must have a page and a valid region, and coordinates outside 0 to 1 are rejected.

sections.name: test_schedule_evidence_uses_named_table_region_without_fake_page
sections.title: Schedule evidence rules
sections.what: Checks a schedule source uses a named table region and must not claim a page number.
sections.why: Stops a schedule from pretending to be a page.

sections.name: test_bundle_rejects_duplicate_missing_and_self_fact_references
sections.title: Bundle reference rules
sections.what: Checks that duplicate fact IDs, references to missing facts, and facts that corroborate themselves are rejected.

sections.name: test_unresolved_conflict_cannot_be_accepted
sections.title: Unresolved conflicts cannot be accepted
sections.what: Checks that a conflicted fact cannot be marked accepted.
sections.why: Stops disputed facts from being used silently.

sections.name: test_forbidden_truth_review_provenance_combinations_fail_closed
sections.title: Forbidden combinations fail
sections.what: Runs several bad combinations of truth state, provenance, conflict status and review status and checks each one is rejected with its message.
sections.watch_out: Each new forbidden combination should get its own case.

sections.name: test_only_reviewed_nonconflicted_evidence_is_model_eligible
sections.title: Only reviewed evidence is model eligible
sections.what: Checks that only an accepted, non-conflicted, supported fact is allowed to influence the model.
sections.why: Keeps unreviewed or unsupported facts out of the model.

sections.name: test_bundle_returns_only_explicitly_accepted_facts
sections.title: Bundle returns accepted facts only
sections.what: Checks a bundle lists its facts by ID and returns only the explicitly accepted ones.
sections.why: Stops unreviewed facts from being returned as accepted.

summary: Checks the rules for evidence records: what truth states exist, which source details a fact needs, when a fact may be accepted, and which facts the model is allowed to use.
purpose: Protects the rule that facts must have a traceable source and a proper review status before the model uses them.
why: Evidence decides what the model is allowed to say. Weak rules would let unreviewed or conflicting facts shape the output.
how: A shared helper builds a valid evidence record with a PDF source and lets each test change one field. Tests check the list of allowed truth states, the page and region rules for PDFs and schedules, bundle rules for duplicates, missing references and self references, conflict rules for acceptance, forbidden combinations of truth, review and provenance, model eligibility, and that only accepted facts are returned.
inputs: Fixed test values such as a hash, a PDF source, and override values chosen by each test.
risks: Adding a new truth state requires updating the expected list. Error text is matched exactly, so wording changes break tests.
debug: Start with the failing test name. Check the record helper first, since most tests use it. For error text mismatches, compare the message in the evidence contracts module.
